title.narrative: Activity under preparation Support measures ¿ Technical Cooperation Facility

description.narrative: The support measures aim to facilitate a well-structured and strategic capacity-building and policy dialogue process with Guatemala, enhancing EU opportunities to stimulate policy reforms and promote the external projection of EU internal policies as well as international standards. They will provide inter alia short-term technical assistance linked to the identification, formulation, monitoring, auditing, and evaluation activities necessary to the efficient implementation of the MIP 2021-2027 intervention strategy, the Global Gateway Investment Agenda and possible short-term actions to accompany policy dialogues. The support measures include the provision of resources aiming at activities such as: organising seminars, meetings, events, training sessions; undertaking thematic studies and publications; supporting twinning actions in areas of interest, exchanging and gathering information; developing online networks; technical assistance on concrete issues, etc. The support measures will optimize the effectiveness and efficiency of the EU intervention, contributing to mitigate the risks and drawing lessons from the EU's previous experience of cooperation.General objective: Contribute to the green, digital and inclusive transition in Guatemala and promote social cohesion, rule of law, human rights and democratic values in line with EU global priorities. Specific objective: Enhance EU opportunities to stimulate policy reforms in Guatemala and support the implementation of the MIP 2021-27, the Global Gateway Investment Agenda and other EU global priorities in Guatemala.
